model_output:
```sql
WITH nature_reserves AS (
  SELECT
    parks.geometry
  FROM
    parks
  WHERE
    parks.leisure ILIKE '%nature reserve%'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM regions r
      WHERE r.region_name ILIKE 'San Mateo County'
        AND r.border_type = 'county'
        AND r.addr_state = 'California'
        AND ST_Intersects(parks.geometry::geometry, r.geometry::geometry)
    )
),
san_mateo_county AS (
  SELECT
    regions.geometry
  FROM
    regions
  WHERE
    regions.region_name ILIKE 'San Mateo County'
    AND regions.border_type = 'county'
    AND regions.addr_state = 'California'
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(r.rast, 1, true, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM san_mateo_county))
),
clipped_slope AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(slope_rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM san_mateo_county), true) AS clipped_rast
  FROM
    slope_raster
)
SELECT
  ROUND(ST_Area((SELECT geometry FROM nature_reserves)::geography) / 1000000, 2) AS total_nature_reserve_area_sqkm,
  ROUND(ST_Stats((SELECT clipped_rast FROM clipped_slope), 1, true).mean, 2) AS average_slope_degrees;
```
